items.title: CountDaysNow: Event Counter — Countdown Plan: Work Backwards | iOS App
items.content_html:
Plan backwards from the dates that matter. Countdown Plan gives any event its own preparation steps, such as renew the passport 30 days before a trip or order the cake 7 days before a birthday, and shows what is late, due today, due in the next 7 days and done across all your events. Each step is due a set number of days before its event. Change the event date and every step moves with it; a repeating event starts each new cycle with a fresh plan. Countdown Plan is free, works on-device and needs no account. Daily Focus saves one private Since / Today / Ahead choice each day and preserves that dated trail as milestones change. No ads, no subscription, no account. One purchase unlocks everything for good. • Ahead · Today · Since CountDaysNow keeps future, current and past events in three clear views, with precise day counts and a date calculator for adding, subtracting or comparing dates. • Events, categories and archive Create and edit events, organize them into categories, search quickly and archive milestones without losing their history. • Recurrence, reminders and Calendar Set repeating events, including an optional end date, schedule reminders and import only the Calendar events you choose. • Widgets, Lock Screen and Dynamic Island Put any event on Home Screen widgets in every size, including iPad Extra Large, keep a live countdown running in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, and let the Next 3 widget show your three closest dates at once. Apple Watch stays useful offline. • Milestone alerts and 15 calendars A gentle nudge arrives 7, 3 and 1 day before, on the day itself, at day 100 and on every anniversary. Any event can show a second calendar beside the Gregorian date: Chinese lunar, Japanese, Hebrew, Persian, Indian, Islamic, Buddhist and more. • 100 skins and share cards Browse all 100 countdown styles before unlocking them, each with its own palette and layout, then export a share card as a square, portrait or story image. • iCloud, shared countdowns and safe updates Events stay in step across your iPhone and iPad through your private iCloud, a single countdown can be shared with other CountDaysNow users and updated together, and a local snapshot is written before every update so nothing goes missing. Free The free edition supports up to 3 active events, 3 categories and 1 reminder for each event, plus one selected event widget. Archived events remain available. One-time Lifetime Pro A single Lifetime Pro purchase—never a subscription—unlocks unlimited events and categories; the complete gallery of 100 exclusive skins; advanced recurrence, reminders and calendars; every widget and the full Apple Watch experience; Badge, photo backgrounds, Face ID, iCloud and JSON backup, and high-resolution sharing. How do iCloud sync and shared countdowns work? With Lifetime Pro, optional iCloud sync keeps events and categories up to date across your devices through your private Apple CloudKit database. Share Countdown sends only the selected event’s title, note, target date, calendar system, time zone, all-day setting, recurrence, symbol and color to the CountDaysNow users you invite; reminders, categories, the Calendar source identifier, favorite and archive status, photo backgrounds and every other event remain private. Sync also carries the technical event identifier, created and updated timestamps, and conflict-resolution metadata; invitees can view and edit only the user-visible fields, not this technical metadata. The owner can stop sharing or delete the shared countdown, and participants can leave it. CountDaysNow uses no accounts, advertising, third-party analytics or tracking tools, and sends no data to developer servers.

App Store · Free

Get CountDaysNow: Event Counter on the App Store

items.title: dB Halo: Sound Meter — Noise Dose, Sleep & Spectrum | iOS App
items.content_html:
Check a busy worksite, aircon, backyard tools or noise around a coastal holiday home. dB Halo gives you a clear, private view of the sound around you while processing stays on your devices. The large Halo safety ring shows live dB, minimum, average, maximum and peak readings, plus a time-stamped event log. Select A, C or Z weighting, connect an external microphone and save multiple calibration profiles. Analyse one live session in three synchronised views: FFT Spectrum, RTA octave bands and Spectrogram. Noise Dose estimates daily exposure against NIOSH or OSHA criteria and shows the remaining safer time. Use it as a practical guide around worksite noise, not as a work health and safety assessment. The on-device Sleep Journal recognises and classifies snoring, breathing, speech, coughing, alarms, animal sounds, impacts, ambient sound and crying, logging each event without retaining raw microphone audio. Microphone audio is not saved by default; an AAC file is created only when you explicitly start a recording. History keeps every saved session organised and ready when you need it. Export selected measurements as visual PDF reports or CSV data, export explicitly recorded AAC files and burn dB overlays onto photos and videos. Export environmental audio levels to Apple Health, check Home and Lock Screen widgets, use App Intents and Shortcuts and take standalone measurements on Apple Watch. No account, ads, analytics or tracking. Everything is processed on your devices. Each general feature that produces a result includes three free uses. Spectrum, Noise Dose and Sleep Journal each include one. A use counts only after a result is created; cancellations, denied permissions and failures do not count, and existing results remain readable. Lifetime Pro is one non-consumable in-app purchase: pay once, own it for good, with no subscription. Readings are estimates. dB Halo is not a certified professional sound level meter and does not replace medical advice or a work health and safety assessment.

App Store · Free
